name: log
description: arcaeon: append one JSON row to a ledger; returns the new chain value. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

row.description: a whole row, instead of fields

name: verify
description: arcaeon: check a ledger's chain: VERIFIED / BROKEN / COULD NOT LOOK. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

content.description: the file's text (JSONL), for an agent with no file access

name: reconcile
description: arcaeon: two tapes and a counter: MATCHED / MISSING / ALTERED / COULD NOT LOOK. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

content_a.description: the file's text (JSONL), for an agent with no file access

content_b.description: the file's text (JSONL), for an agent with no file access

name: audit_verify
description: arcaeon: verify an audit log or an exported bundle. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

content.description: the file's text (JSONL), for an agent with no file access

name: audit_export
description: arcaeon: export a ledger as an audit bundle into a directory under the served root. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: receipt_verify
description: arcaeon: verify a portable receipt. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

content.description: the file's text (JSONL), for an agent with no file access

name: status
description: arcaeon: what arcaeon did lately here: last run per verb, open COULD NOT LOOKs. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: pin
description: arcaeon: record a ledger head in a local witness file under the served root (remote pin is the paid lane). Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: evidence_pack
description: arcaeon: build an evidence pack for a ledger and a time window. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: evidence_pack_verify
description: arcaeon: verify an evidence pack: every file rehashed, the chain, the window, the pins. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

remote.description: also read the pack's remote pins (network; unreachable is COULD NOT LOOK, reason network)

name: export_aat
description: arcaeon: write a ledger out in the agent-audit-trail format. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: mandate_check
description: arcaeon: check a call against a mandate (record-only: says inside or outside, blocks nothing). Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: readings
description: arcaeon: submit one reader's reading of a claim, chained into a readings ledger. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: second_read_compare
description: arcaeon: line up two readings ledgers: COMPARED / MISSING / BROKEN / COULD NOT LOOK. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

content_a.description: the file's text (JSONL), for an agent with no file access

content_b.description: the file's text (JSONL), for an agent with no file access

name: handshake_propose
description: arcaeon: propose terms to another agent; each side keeps its own ledger. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: handshake_accept
description: arcaeon: countersign proposed terms. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).

name: handshake_verify
description: arcaeon: line up both sides' ledgers: AGREED TERMS / DIFFERENT TERMS / MISSING / COULD NOT LOOK. Returns JSON with an integer `exit`: 0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK (not a pass).
